line_evidence.text: A1.4.1 Evaluate the translation processes of interpreters and compilers.
• The mechanics and use-cases of each translation approach
• The difference in error detection, translation time, portability and applicability for different translation
processes, including just-in-time compilation (JIT) and bytecode interpreters
• Example scenarios where the translation method should be considered must include rapid
development and testing, performance-critical applications and cross-platform development.
